title: openclaw 2026.11.1
summary:
2026.11.1

Highlights

  • Safer Mac settings: failed config saves no longer overwrite secrets, and turning off Tailscale exposure keeps Gateway authentication intact. (#187734, #187664) Fixes #187600, #187597 Thanks @anmol0b.
  • More reliable channel replies: Telegram, Discord, and webhook conversations keep reaching the agent after request handlers or earlier turns finish. (#179200, #179385, #179704, #189457) Fixes #178554 Thanks @steipete, @LiuwqGit, @jalehman, and @vincentkoc.
  • Conversations survive more interruptions: oversized turns retain useful history, and stopping the first Claude CLI turn no longer starts the next message from scratch. (#191146, #181966, #186380) Fixes #191133, #181945 Thanks @Yun-0000, @obviyus, @mirasrael, and @holgergruenhagen.
  • Update recovery gets unstuck after crashed or canceled updaters, restores the Windows Gateway after failed verification, and avoids repeated full-database copying during large-state checks. (#177932, #186787, #189647, #182632, #187921) Fixes #177684, #184893, #189620 Thanks @duyufansh2008, @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, @TheAngryPit, @sukhdeepjohar, @steipete, @syxscott, and @stephen3303.
  • Subagents keep their follow-ups through model and session changes, while parent sessions receive child approvals even with a custom session store. (#186238, #183501, #189827) Fixes #179289, #189823 Thanks @steipete, @Marvinthebored, @RomneyDa, and @ekinnee.
  • Android End Talk with a compatible Gateway stops listening without canceling accepted agent work, so its answer can still arrive in chat; explicit cancellation remains available. (#172276, #188798) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Provider recovery respects provider-specified rate-limit timing, and Gemini Flash text models use Interactions by default on the official API-key endpoint while custom proxies retain their existing default. (#180280, #189395) Thanks Ayaan Zaidi, @evomach, @sukhdeepjohar, @RomneyDa.

Changes

  • Claude CLI: saved subscription accounts can make configured models available without a separate native login, and operators can opt into native Agent and Workflow orchestration through plugins.entries.anthropic.config.managedNativeTools; the default remains off and restricted runs keep their existing tool limits. (#179203, #183765) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Anthropic: API-key setup can record an optional Anthropic workspace ID; existing workspace headers are preserved, and workspace-scoped keys need no extra setting. (#186976) Thanks Ayaan Zaidi, @evomach, @sukhdeepjohar, @RomneyDa.
  • Google: Interactions requests honor managed proxy and TLS settings, rotate eligible API keys before streaming after a rate limit, preserve native video input, and forward nucleus sampling consistently; choose google-generative-ai when explicit Gemini cache handles are required. (#189395, #190695) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Bedrock Mantle: discovered numbered OpenAI GPT models select the Responses route automatically, while GPT-OSS keeps Chat Completions and Claude keeps Anthropic Messages. Thanks @MertBasar0, @anmol0b, @shakkernerd, @kybrcore, @sukhdeepjohar, @potoior, @RomneyDa.
  • Control UI: the model picker shows the configured active context budget rather than only the model maximum, and short session links retain their intended navigation target. (#180870, #183148) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Google Chat: remote HTTP(S) attachments are delivered as visible links alongside captions; local files and native uploads remain unsupported with service-account authentication. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Update diagnostics: detailed readiness separates a ready core from channel outages, allowing repaired updaters to finish with named channel warnings without hiding HTTP 503 or weakening normal service-start checks. Thanks @duyufansh2008, @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Network and tool safety: ClickClack and ClawHub reject redirects into unrelated private services, Discord CDN downloads no longer inherit browser private-network access, and FIFO native-hook credentials are rejected without hanging the agent. (#190944, #190939, #191458, #191423) Thanks @pgondhi987, @SebTardif, and @Leon-SK668.
  • Doctor consent and access policy: noninteractive checks no longer download plugins without repair consent, and explicitly empty group allowlists remain empty instead of being repopulated. (#191523, #174787) Fixes #191420, #173826 Thanks @brandonulrich, @steipete, and @lockhartheavyindustries.
  • Recovery data: malformed UTF-8 legacy imports are rejected instead of replacing original content; failed skill restore rollbacks preserve the original copy, and cleanup refuses destructive work when workspace inspection fails. (#180861, #173954, #174195, #176362) Fixes #180782, #180795 Thanks @RomneyDa, @duyufansh2008, @steipete, and @wangmiao0668000666.
  • Log redaction: malformed custom entries no longer disable valid rules or built-in secret protection; invalid policy is reported while safe redaction remains active. (#173471) Thanks @skyzhao1223 and @RomneyDa.
  • Secret egress: reject chains relying on the distrusted emSign ECC G3 root in the managed proxy and exported subprocess CA bundle; restart the Gateway after updating, and update clients with independent trust stores separately. (#179249) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • macOS connectivity: configured credentials take precedence over stale app environment, typed environment secret references resolve correctly, and remote Settings respects the Control UI base path. (#191468, #185141, #128175) Fixes #164596 Thanks @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, and @goldmar.
  • Mac tools and messaging: iMessage remains usable after app updates without re-granting Automation, Peekaboo window inspection accepts valid snapshot references, and node exec preserves results for commands configured without a timeout. (#186107, #172116, #190729) Fixes #178719 Thanks @aniketkrs, @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, @SharkeyDev, @holgergruenhagen, @LiuwqGit, and @etzelm.
  • Mac voice and embedded pages: avoid duplicate voice sends and false sent feedback, and show a recoverable load error instead of a blank or stale Mac tab. (#186271, #185432) Thanks @anmol0b, @etzelm, and @RomneyDa.
  • Native voice and capture: iOS and macOS Talk tolerate slow audio acknowledgments within bounded buffering, long meeting replies are not cut off merely because generation outruns playback, and oversized Mac recordings fail with size guidance instead of dropping the node connection. Thanks @MertBasar0, @anmol0b, @shakkernerd, @kybrcore, @sukhdeepjohar, @potoior, and @RomneyDa.
  • Android and desktop compatibility: Android Chat waits for the role-allowed agent list after switching Gateways, and independently updated Mac nodes can return optional cursor coordinates without a computer-use contract error. Thanks @MertBasar0, @anmol0b, @shakkernerd, @kybrcore, @sukhdeepjohar, @potoior, @RomneyDa.
  • Channel recovery: Slack detects dead relay connections without treating ordinary silence as failure, Tlon reconnects stalled streams so unacknowledged events can replay, and managed Tailscale exposure recovers after a daemon restart while local authenticated access stays available. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Channel delivery: Feishu keeps text from before and after tool calls in the same streaming card; Synology confirms delivery only from recipient-matched message IDs; Twitch targets and Zalo unsupported-event text follow their channel handling rather than silently losing usable content. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Channel credentials and notices: implicit Slack default accounts retain complete top-level credentials alongside named accounts, channel secret consumers respect account activation, and Nostr reports failed pairing notifications without undoing approval. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • iMessage storage: recovery cursor keys no longer contain a PostgreSQL-incompatible NUL separator, allowing the channel to start with PostgreSQL-backed state. (#184919) Fixes #184862 Thanks @duyufansh2008, @RomneyDa, and @etzelm.
  • Session and agent authority: deleting one agent no longer breaks other agents' tool authority, and local session-capability changes stop inappropriate provider fallback instead of trying every model. (#174918, #179312) Fixes #179290 Thanks @steipete, @chelsealong, @obviyus, and @Marvinthebored.
  • Prompt caching: session tool definitions stay stable across turns, including completions, heartbeats, and non-owner requests, avoiding unnecessary prompt-cache misses. (#175309, #176167) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Conversation recovery: compaction retains the active human request across repeated summaries; queue overflow summaries retain each visible sender and conversation context; exec completion guidance survives overflow. (#180214, #187833, #190698, #182188, #184216) Thanks @RomneyDa and @aniketkrs.
  • Codex continuity: conversation-wide restrictions retain compatible native threads, temporary restrictions preserve the ordinary conversation binding, and a missing thread with recorded history reports an error instead of silently starting over. Thanks @skyzhao1223 and @RomneyDa.
  • Codex replies: transient retries can summarize the original request and completed tools without rerunning them; terminal handoffs allow already-submitted steering a bounded chance to confirm consumption and do not automatically replay uncertain input. (#183077, #184062, #181839, #167390) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Shared credentials and model availability: concurrent MCP callers can reuse a fresh OAuth token without unnecessary exclusive locking, rate-limit cooldowns follow provider timing instead of accumulating hours of local backoff, and fresh model publications replace superseded refresh results. (#179997, #180280, #179144) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Claude CLI and scheduled work: canceled cron runs stop reply hooks, interrupted long-running jobs no longer prevent scheduler startup, oversized or invalid CLI streams cancel their subprocess promptly, and managed completions retain the policy-filtered tool catalog. (#181245, #191422, #159931, #172026) Thanks @steipete and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Session history and memory: long transcript decoding releases database read snapshots promptly, bounded history pages keep their requested anchors and adjacent messages, and memory indexing waits for archived transcript materialization. (#164442, #172970, #177937, #182091, #190182, #189284, #188450, #188483, #190690) Fixes #171467 Thanks @RomneyDa, and @etzelm.
  • Subagent and restart recovery: live descendants keep their expired parents available for communication, accepted yields settle sibling tool results before handoff, and stale interrupted input no longer blocks a new human message indefinitely. (#179057, #184021, #180853, #181871, #178888, #184041, #184069, #172959) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Agent handoffs: waiting session sends recover the stored long reply instead of returning only a short lifecycle preview, and ACP-created sessions retain the requested working directory for later prompts. (#178271, #176852) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Control UI recovery: silently dead Gateway connections reconnect without replaying uncertain sends, consumed slash-steering messages leave the queue, and routine restart notices stay concise. (#179101, #178642, #180024, #172843) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • GitHub workflows: active sessions can open the reconnect flow, failed follow-up pushes retain the existing PR, and readers no longer hang while discarding response bodies. (#180200, #187835, #191721) Fixes #187832 Thanks @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, @obviyus, and @nocodet888-arch.
  • Plugin lifecycle: startup avoids recopying managed binaries, repairs owned stale host links after installation-root changes, and keeps plugin background readers alive for admitted callbacks and cleanup; internal plugin reload resumes stay in the current session rather than using an old external recipient. (#187865, #181140, #182207, #179031, #181270, #179549, #190982) Thanks @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @RomneyDa, @jasonftl, and @obviyus.
  • Gateway startup and shutdown: retry transient database locks during stale-claim cleanup and sidecar startup, and exit after clean shutdown instead of waiting for systemd to kill a process with a leaked handle. (#187724, #186920, #191251) Fixes #187723, #186875, #191119 Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @steipete, @yousan, @bianyuxia-commits, and @davesanvil.
  • Update startup and migration: recover with retained worker indexes, avoid crashes in automatic migration recovery from 2026.10.7–2026.10.9, preserve recovery errors, and reject Git targets that require an unavailable newer Node before staging. (#189023, #189713, #191495, #181715) Thanks @RomneyDa and @steipete.
  • Update repair: release abandoned cancellation custody and resolve pending package steps without repair loops; restore a suspended Windows Gateway task after failed verification while retaining the original failure details. (#177932, #186787, #189647) Fixes #177684, #184893, #189620 Thanks @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, @TheAngryPit, @sukhdeepjohar, @steipete, @syxscott, and @stephen3303.
  • Update captures and service handoff: ignore Finder metadata when listing recovery captures, recover CLI Node runtimes when launched from /, and classify an unavailable automatic-update service handoff as skipped rather than an unrecorded failure. (#186663, #178112, #188405) Fixes #186650, #177739, #188302 Thanks @duyufansh2008, @RomneyDa, @steipete, @woshicby, @downingkeys, and @ARSA31.
  • Doctor migrations: bound long Matrix archive filenames, preserve config promotion when only migration guidance changes, run explicitly requested headless repairs, return failure rather than success when required work was skipped, and retain invalid heartbeat quiet hours with actionable validation. (#187443, #190665, #187192, #186305) Fixes #187390, #190658, #187122 Thanks @RomneyDa, @skyzhao1223, @steipete, @dakoller, @saariuslystoned, and @JordanNewell.
  • Configuration and store recovery: explain how to recover when an older binary meets newer config; relative session stores resolve against the active state directory, and Doctor merges legacy misplaced stores with backups while preserving conflicting conversations and refusing unsafe retirement. (#187639, #182444, #181554, #180414, #179089) Fixes #152791 Thanks @RomneyDa, @duyufansh2008, @steipete, and @kip-claw.
  • Service and backup reliability: repaired updaters distinguish durable database changes from read-only WAL bookkeeping, wait for the serving Mac child to release state, preserve valid replacement config without metadata, and keep unrelated service overrides intact during supported Node repairs. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Diagnostics and provider tools: timeout messages distinguish an unknown tool outcome from a safe retry, Anthropic PDF requests use the selected account's proper authentication, and Gemini/Vertex streams stop at terminal markers instead of consuming later frames. (#180247, #182429, #184434, #178420, #117397) Thanks Ayaan Zaidi, @evomach, @sukhdeepjohar, @RomneyDa, @MertBasar0, @anmol0b, @shakkernerd, @kybrcore, @potoior.

title: openclaw 2026.11.5-beta.1
summary:
2026.11.5-beta.1

Highlights

  • Knowledge Scribes: add first-class knowledge capture and reusable scribe workflows across agents, sessions, and the Control UI. (#185583, #185637, #185974, #186270, #186455, #187659) Thanks @jalehman.
  • PostgreSQL data plane: add PostgreSQL-backed state, migration tooling, and compatibility coverage for existing deployments. (#173968, #174080, #174085, #174183, #174242, #174374, #174387, #174399, #174623) Authored by @steipete.
  • Control UI: overhaul mobile and desktop navigation, layouts, and interaction details. (#176356, #176466, #176505, #176540, #176557, #176653) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Pull requests from chat: add end-to-end PR preparation, publication, review, and status workflows directly from conversations. (#176105, #176139, #178055, #178233, #178281, #178756) Thanks @shakkernerd.
  • Cross-device and cloud execution: expand attached-device, cloud-placement, and cyber-access workflows, including safer capability handoffs. (#185230, #185477, #186560, #187408; related #186553) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @VACInc, @joshavant, @galiniliev, and @shakkernerd.
  • Decision and media models: add specialized decision routing and media-capable model support, including ClawRouter integrations. (#177369, #178860, #178876, #178886, #178920, #179362; related #179360) Thanks @vincentkoc and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Plugin experience: improve plugin discovery, installation, authoring, and runtime integration. (#177869, #182419, #185315, #185544) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @jalehman.
  • Backup and upgrade safety: harden backup, recovery, and upgrade paths with clearer state preservation and rollback behavior. (#186953, #187564, #187688, #187737; fixes #187519, #187678, #187657) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @art22s, @RomneyDa, @McgAtom, and @Yachiyo1680.

Changes

  • Automations: add persistent streams and richer execution context for durable scheduled work. (#177941, #177942, #179011, #179062, #179669, #182561) Thanks @joshavant, @eleqtrizit, and @jalehman.
  • Sharing and guests: expand session sharing, guest access, and visitor lifecycle controls. (#181680, #182218, #182337, #182352) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @shakkernerd and @jalehman.
  • Learning and skills: improve learned-skill capture, reuse, and guided authoring. (#181747, #181879, #186861) Thanks @obviyus and @jalehman.
  • Providers: add and refine provider integrations, authentication, and model discovery. (#175509, #175729, #180788, #182248; related #175543) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @midhunvnadh, @obviyus, @lavicosa, and @hannesrudolph.
  • Native media: expand native image, audio, and video handling across supported surfaces. (#174051, #174152, #178521; related #174048) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @dankarization, and @lordratner.
  • Session composition: improve multi-session composition, routing, and coordinated execution. (#178842, #179609, #182742) Thanks @jalehman and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Credential compatibility: improve credential migration and compatibility across legacy and current configuration formats. (#174294, #174599) Authored by @steipete.
  • Doctor compatibility: broaden doctor checks and automated repair guidance for migrated installations. (#179387, #182328) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman.
  • Memory maintenance: add safer memory cleanup and maintenance flows. (#182530; fixes #157280) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @islandpreneur007.
  • Model routing: improve provider-aware model selection and routing behavior. (#180509, #183637) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @VACInc and @tommyjoseph.

Fixes

  • Gateway startup: fix startup recovery, dependency ordering, and service-state handling across upgrades. (#186920, #187724, #187819, #187870; fixes #186875, #187723) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @yousan, @bianyuxia-commits, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @fuller-stack-dev, and @vincentkoc.
  • Codex: fix session lifecycle, result delivery, and tool-state edge cases in Codex-backed workflows. (#187337, #187348, #187375, #187873; fixes #187023, #187863) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen, @wtfichigo, @obviyus, and @shakkernerd.
  • Reply correctness: fix reply threading, quoting, deduplication, and destination selection across channel surfaces. (#187361, #187416, #187433, #187434, #187833; fixes #137197, #42106) Thanks @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @obviyus, @wyf027, @felixboenkost-droid, @ericcaiwx-star, @wbxl2000, @goslingmanagment, and @dmsrg399.
  • Channels and Talk: fix admission, audio, delivery, and reconnect behavior across supported messaging and Talk integrations. (#186757, #187199, #187327, #187497, #187667, #187864, #187881; fixes #186756, #127534, #187665, #185664) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @wangmiao0668000666, @yousan, @xialonglee, @HermanZeng, @brianmcguire, and @ultrakorne.
  • Outbound media: fix media attachment handling and preservation on outbound sends. (#187561; fixes #187359) Thanks @yousan, @obviyus, and @fonchaves.
  • Control UI accessibility: fix keyboard, focus, labeling, and responsive interaction regressions. (#180896, #187219, #187263, #187521; fixes #187201) Thanks @goutamadwant, @LiuwqGit, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @Alix-007.
  • Control UI attachments: prevent aborted data: URL attachment previews from triggering a native fetch crash. (#191451) Thanks @tideclaw-bot, @wangjx-xydt, and @RomneyDa.
  • Memory: fix indexing, retrieval, migration, and cleanup edge cases. (#186829, #187429, #187621, #187797; fixes #187788) Thanks @SunnyShu0925, @obviyus, @Baumus, @Leon-SK668, and @fredtanxo.
  • Providers: fix provider authentication, discovery, and request compatibility issues, including restoring Claude CLI model discovery when no Anthropic model is pinned. (#181527, #187365, #187523, #191148; fixes #151015, #143214) Thanks @KrasimirKralev, @obviyus, @yousan, @masatohoshino, @wyf027, @HighervGround, @etzelm, and @Takhoffman.
  • Automations: fix scheduler execution and persisted-run recovery edge cases. (#187195, #187530; fixes #187334) Thanks @obviyus, @yousan, and @etzelm.
  • Doctor: prevent hosted Doctor runs from stalling live sessions by bounding worker lifetime and cancellation. (#191125) Authored by @steipete.

title: v2.1.318
summary:
What's changed

  • Added a record of your answer when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session
  • Added assume_role on mantle upstreams of the Claude apps gateway, for a role in another AWS account and for per-developer AWS cost attribution
  • Added an effort option to a mod's $.model.fork, so a quick side job can run at low whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent
  • Added the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to claude auth status (loginExpiresAt) and to claude -p JSON results (credential_expires_at)
  • Added a one-line stderr warning to claude -p text output, starting 10 days before a stored claude.ai sign-in ends
  • Fixed --continue sometimes losing the earlier conversation after a malformed tool call's retries ran out (regression in 2.1.314)
  • Fixed macOS sessions with many running Bash commands stalling while memory grew
  • Fixed permission prompts being answered by keys typed just after sending a message, or before a slow prompt appeared
  • Fixed /logout, claude auth logout and claude mcp remove reporting success, and changes to trust, consent or MCP settings being dropped with no word, when the config file could not be updated on a shared network home directory
  • Fixed jobs exiting with Not logged in when another terminal or host signs in again to the same account and organization on the same home
  • Fixed claude mcp add and remove writing the config without its lock: they now wait for it or exit 1, though another job's save can still replace a saved server
  • Fixed claude plugin commands exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
  • Fixed claude plugin validate passing a custom-named marketplace file that claude plugin marketplace add rejects
  • Fixed stdio MCP servers that exit on the version probe being re-probed on every start; a server that dies in under 3s for its own reason is also pinned to the legacy handshake for 7 days
  • Fixed sessions being refused at startup by an allowedProviders list that another login on the same machine had stored
  • Fixed idle compaction replacing a conversation with a reply that was not a summary
  • Fixed the "Now using usage credits" notice reappearing about every 30 seconds while a background subagent is running
  • Fixed custom slash commands that fail, or that only Claude can invoke, printing nothing in claude -p and SDK sessions
  • Fixed claude -p and Agent SDK sessions reporting success when an API error cut off a reply while a mod hooked turn.step
  • Fixed a message sent right after a model change still running after Stop in headless sessions: Stop now cancels or stops it as it would a queued message
  • Fixed a deleted session transcript being re-created with its last prompt when an idle non-interactive session exited
  • Fixed claude remote-control hosts, the background daemon and self-hosted runners failing to start new sessions (spawn ENOENT) after an update or version cleanup removed the binary of a still-running process
  • Fixed a running Claude Code process owned by another user (for example one left by sudo claude) being treated as dead by version cleanup, which could delete its binary
  • Fixed /remote-control showing a session as available after a failed connection
  • Fixed /design revoke reporting success when the request failed with a 404
  • Fixed a shell command approved after a self-hosted runner or cloud session restart running in the session's start folder, not the folder it was asked in; if that folder can't be entered, it is not run
  • Fixed Claude not being told when an approved connector tool was unavailable after a cloud session restart
  • Fixed cloud sessions being stopped in the middle of a turn when the service refuses uploads for several minutes
  • Fixed variables a Setup hook writes to CLAUDE_ENV_FILE not reaching the Bash tool in some cloud sessions
  • Fixed the iPhone app showing a cloud session's turn as finished while it kept running, after a response was cut off at a tool call or a refused image or document was removed
  • Fixed a restarted session re-sending a message that failed with an API error, ahead of the newer message waiting behind it
  • Fixed a restarted session dropping its interrupted turn when the restart came right after Claude read a large image or retried a tool call
  • Fixed every connection failing when the NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS file is empty, not PEM, or starts with a damaged certificate: readable certificates are now used, with a warning on stderr
  • Fixed workflows re-running finished agents when resumed after a usage limit
  • Fixed /mcp in cloud sessions counting tools the model can't use; a server's row now shows how many of its tools are available
  • Fixed a duplicate notification when Claude left the status field out of a PushNotification call
  • Fixed the error for a too-large image in a request with more than 20 images always saying the limit was 2000px; it now shows the API's limit
  • Fixed the runtime in background shell details not updating while the dialog is open
  • Fixed a mod's turn.step hook making a stopped reply finish as a success in headless runs
  • Fixed retention cleanup leaving a home that only runs claude -p with no ~/.claude.json backup: it now takes a fresh backup before deleting the last good one
  • Fixed the stored login being replaced by an empty file when a network home directory has no room left for data but still takes new files
  • Fixed tokens from setup-token being refused at start on machines with forceLoginOrgUUID, when the token belongs to a permitted organization
  • Fixed non-interactive launches replacing a ~/.claude.json that isn't valid JSON with defaults; the start now fails, says how to restore the file, and leaves it as is (#87551)
  • Fixed an empty ~/.claude.json with no backup being reported as corrupted; Claude Code now starts as it does when the file is missing
  • Fixed the restore command printed for a damaged or missing ~/.claude.json naming an empty or cut-off backup, or failing on a read-only file
  • Fixed the sign-in failure when a stored claude.ai login reaches its time limit: it now says so, and in claude -p names claude auth login and claude setup-token
  • Improved how ~/.claude.json, settings files and the stored login survive saves on shared network home directories: they are less often deleted, briefly emptied or replaced by a near-empty or older copy
  • Improved sessions on network file systems to look again when the configuration file is wrongly reported as missing, so fewer start without your MCP servers and trusted folders
  • Improved MCP tool errors: a call made before the tool is loaded now returns its input schema
  • Improved the reliability of git commits and pull request creation when the Bash tool runs macOS's built-in /bin/bash
  • Improved "Ask your admin for more usage" in the usage limit menu to send the request in one step
  • Improved how fast remote sessions reconnect after a pause or sleep
  • Improved You should know toasts to say "try again" instead of "press 2", which only works in the terminal
  • Improved auto-update reliability: a brief network failure while verifying a release is now retried right away instead of waiting for the next check
  • Improved unattended runs (claude -p, SDK apps) to stop rewriting ~/.claude.json on every run when nothing in it changed
  • Changed Claude Code to no longer install or update the IDE extension when started in an IDE terminal; use /ide from an outside terminal or your editor's extensions view
  • Changed subagents to stop instead of switching models when "Switch models when a message is flagged" is set to "Ask each time"
  • Changed background subagents to move a shell command to the background after 3 minutes on all providers, so the prompt cache doesn't expire while it runs
  • Changed subagent progress summaries on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or with telemetry off: on a cold prompt cache, one can now wait up to 5 minutes for the subagent's pending response
  • Changed what a mod attaches at prompt.submit to stay in the user's turn rather than go out as a system message
  • Changed deniedMcpServers URL entries to also block Anthropic-provided servers whose upstream URL matches, and connectors in cloud sessions and on self-hosted runners, where the session is given the connector's own URL; otherwise deny a connector by name
  • Changed the /permissions rule details, built-in rules and delete confirmation views to use the standard dialog; pressing Ctrl+C twice there now goes back or cancels instead of quitting
  • Changed /claude-api managed-agents-onboard to give a new agent's built-in tools, and a quickstart template's MCP tools, the auto permission policy ("Judge risky actions") by default, matching the Claude Console; say "run without asking" to opt out
  • Removed the 2.1.288 fix that kept the model's earlier thinking when resuming a conversation started on 2.1.286 or earlier; that thinking can now be dropped
  • Gateway: Added a log warning when the Google access token from a federation (external_account) credentials file is about to expire
  • Gateway: Improved the log hints about listen.trusted_proxies: they now say to list only a proxy that adds the connecting address to X-Forwarded-For itself
  • Gateway: Improved the warning when AWS CountTokens fails on Amazon Bedrock: it says Claude Code, not the gateway, counts after the 501, and points at IAM only when AWS denies access
  • Self-hosted runner: Added CLAUDE_RUNNER_SPAWN_REASON to the orchestrator's spawn-runner hook environment: why Anthropic sent the request (e.g. runner_lost, resumed); unset when none was sent
  • Self-hosted runner: Added a startup warning when --release-idle-session-min is the last argument with no value (still ignored) or has a value of only spaces (still read as 0)
  • Self-hosted runner: Changed the orchestrator's log lines: ok session=… now prints at every log level on stdout (was debug only, stderr) with reason=… after jti=…, and nack session=… ends its fields with reason=… after retryable=…; update scripts that match retryable=true: or retryable=false:
  • Remote Control: Fixed a misleading "spawn error: ENOENT" when a session's working folder is missing; the error now names the folder
  • Remote Control: Improved the title a fork of a terminal fork is created with when the app doesn't set one: "Name (fork 2)"
  • [VSCode] Fixed a window whose sign-in the organization's settings refuse starting a new Claude Code process in the background every minute
  • [VSCode] Fixed a long word in the chat panel's error banner pushing its close button out of view
  • [VSCode] Improved the sign-in screen to show what Claude Code printed when its sign-in status check fails
  • [Cloud sessions] Added a No repository option: a cloud session on an Anthropic-hosted environment can now start without picking a repository
  • [Cloud sessions] Added the usual Chrome names to cloud sessions, so tools other than Playwright can find the built-in Chromium through google-chrome and CHROME_PATH
  • [Cloud sessions] Added a New session button to the card shown when a cloud session's environment was deleted, where the message box is hidden
  • [Cloud sessions] Fixed reading GitHub Actions logs in cloud sessions: gh run view --log and gh api log requests now get the log in most environments, not an unreachable redirect
  • [Cloud sessions] Improved most Create PR failure messages in cloud and Remote Control sessions: they now give the reason or a link to GitHub instead of saying Try again
  • [Cloud sessions] Changed connector search results to tell Claude that the search covers only part of the connector directory
  • [Remote Control] Fixed side-by-side checkouts of one repository looking identical in the environment menu's Remote Control rows; each now shows its own folder name
  • [Claude Tag] Fixed keyboard focus and screen reader announcements in Claude Tag admin setup; pressing Escape in the connect form no longer also closes the Add dialog
  • [Code Review] Improved the Code Review analytics page to retry once after a server or network failure, then show a Try again banner instead of empty cards

title: Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0
summary:
🎉 Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 - Now Generally Available!

We're excited to announce the v1.0 release of Claude Code GitHub Action! This major release brings significant improvements in simplicity, flexibility, and power to AI-assisted development workflows.

🚀 What's New in v1.0

Simplified Configuration

  • Automatic mode detection - No more manual mode configuration. The action intelligently determines whether to run in interactive or automation mode based on your setup
  • Unified interface - All prompts now go through a single prompt input, and all CLI options through claude_args
  • Better SDK alignment - Closer integration with the Claude Code CLI for a consistent experience

More Powerful & Flexible

  • Direct access to all Claude Code CLI capabilities through claude_args
  • Support for custom system prompts, tool configurations, and model selection
  • Enhanced compatibility with AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI

⚠️ Breaking Changes

This release includes breaking changes from v0.x. Key deprecated inputs have been replaced with a cleaner, more intuitive API:

  • mode, direct_prompt, override_prompt → unified prompt input
  • custom_instructions, model, allowed_tools, mcp_config → claude_args with CLI format
  • Other deprecated: disallowed_tools, anthropic_model, trigger_phrase, timeout_minutes

📚 Please review our Migration Guide for detailed upgrade instructions and examples.

💡 New Use Cases & Examples

Explore the expanded possibilities with v1.0! We've created comprehensive examples showcasing various workflows:

  • Automated PR Reviews - Intelligent code review on every pull request
  • CI Failure Fixes - Automatically diagnose and fix failing tests
  • Issue Triage - Smart categorization and response to new issues
  • Documentation Generation - Keep docs in sync with code changes
  • Security Scanning - Proactive vulnerability detection
  • And many more!

🔧 Check out all examples at github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples

🏃 Quick Start

# Interactive mode - responds to @claude mentions
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

# Automation mode - runs immediately with prompt
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    prompt: "Review this PR for security issues"
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    claude_args: |
      --model claude-4-0-sonnet-20250805
      --max-turns 10

📖 Resources

  • Migration Guide - Step-by-step upgrade instructions
  • Examples - Ready-to-use workflow templates
  • Documentation - Complete setup and configuration guide

🙏 Thank You

Thank you to our beta users for your invaluable feedback that shaped this release. We're excited to see what you'll build with Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0!
